title: Bumper: Scam of the Week
mood: sly and low; lands unresolved on Bb7(b9)
description: Segment bumper for Scam of the Week, built from Zoo's motif (3.4 s).
usage: Cut on the downbeat at the segment change: the file starts with two frames of silence, so start it at downbeatStartFrame(cue, cutFrame) (2 frames early). The music is finished before the file ends. -16 LUFS-I.
selfReview: Low and sly: the motif in piano octaves and pizzicato over a cymbal scrape, landing unresolved on Bb7(b9), then a vibes tritone glint (E then Bb). Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): the kick is tuned to the bass under it (on the landing it no longer beats against B-flat) and sits 12.4 dB under the mix there; the bass is the dark finger-plucked one. It leans towards the noir spy idiom; the minor-major Bond chord stays out on purpose. Critic round 2 (2026-11-24): release-ready; re-rendered with the shared fixes (measured tuning, the decaying FingerBass, one kick tuning, the band compressors, the -1.5 dBTP sting ceiling). Master limiter 0.61 dB at most; -2.0 dBTP after AAC 128k (worst of ten), -1.4 dBTP after Opus 128k.
